summary: Accendra Health filed an 8-K announcing the expiration and final settlement of exchange offers and consent solicitations for its outstanding 2029 and 2030 senior notes. Holders tendered ~99.9% ($478.3M) of 2029 notes and ~99.2% ($548.0M) of 2030 notes. The company issued $539.25M of new First Lien Notes (including $326.25M for new money) and $698.1M of Second Lien Notes in exchange. Remaining outstanding notes are negligible. This debt restructuring reduces near-term maturities and improves the capital structure. Watch for potential further liability management or credit upgrades.
